assertion: A learner remains trainable while its fragments carry different global versions
counterexample: Training blocks until every fragment reaches one common version vector
authoritative_observation: per-boundary version vector optimizer-step sequence and finite token-weighted loss
aggregation: from the first post-adoption mixed-version training step through the final requested step
close_condition: at least five consecutive completed mixed-version optimizer steps have finite loss and no alignment wait or distributed application communication

assertion: A verified newer complete global fragment is applied only after a complete inner step and resets only that fragment's step and token counters
counterexample: A partial or mid-step value is copied or every fragment counter is reset
authoritative_observation: verified content identity safe-boundary step target parameter digest and before/after per-fragment counters
aggregation: every formal adoption plus active-gradient and malformed-payload fixtures
close_condition: every adoption occurs at a strictly increasing zero-gradient boundary target bytes match the verified state and only the target counters reset

assertion: Adoption overwrites parameters while retaining the exact inner optimizer state for every parameter by default
counterexample: Adam moments for the target fragment are cleared or recreated
authoritative_observation: canonical per-fragment optimizer-state hashes immediately before and after each audited adoption
aggregation: all formal adoptions after AdamW moment initialization plus explicit reset surrogate
close_condition: all before/after optimizer-state hashes are byte-identical and the default adoption path has no moment-reset operation

assertion: Each pending fragment is independently adoptable without a full version-vector equality condition
counterexample: A newer fragment waits forever because unrelated fragments have older versions
authoritative_observation: independent pending and applied indices plus mixed version vectors
aggregation: all formal boundaries from first discovery through the end of training
close_condition: target fragments advance independently while at least one unrelated fragment remains at its old version and training continues

assertion: An in-flight old-base proposal remains bytewise and metadata immutable across a later adoption
counterexample: Adoption rewrites the base version identity or parameters of an already-started proposal
authoritative_observation: frozen in-flight proposal base/content/payload identities before adoption and after publication
aggregation: one deliberately gated old-base publication with later target adoption
close_condition: the old proposal retains its original base metadata and payload while later captures use the newly adopted base context

assertion: If the current slot advances from v through intermediate versions to v+k before discovery the learner directly adopts v+k
counterexample: The learner replays every intermediate state or refuses a non-unit version jump
authoritative_observation: adoption from/to versions observed content identity and skipped-intermediate count
aggregation: deterministic v to v+3 fixture and formal latest-current publication
close_condition: the trace contains a direct jump with skipped_intermediate_versions at least two and no intermediate application

assertion: Adoption changes only the complete target fragment parameter identity
counterexample: A parameter in any non-target fragment changes during target adoption
authoritative_observation: full per-fragment parameter hashes immediately before and after audited application
aggregation: every formal adoption and tied-ownership fixture
close_condition: the target post-hash equals the verified global payload hash and every non-target before/after hash is identical

assertion: Sustained end-to-end inner training remains finite under a mixed-version local model
counterexample: Loss becomes nonfinite or optimizer steps stop after the first mixed-version adoption
authoritative_observation: consecutive safe-boundary losses steps version vectors and distributed state
aggregation: first post-adoption mixed-version step through final requested formal step
close_condition: S1-08 component evidence has at least five consecutive finite mixed-version steps with exact step continuity and S1-12 remains the primary full-loop closure
